reference_limitation: Zenodo labels are semi-automatic HSBA+Otsu masks, not expert ground truth; they may favour Otsu, cover only part of the scene, have unknown patch dates, and represent water, not a change map.
otsu_circularity: The reference masks were produced using HSBA plus Otsu and morphological cleaning. Otsu is therefore not an independent comparator and may agree with the labels by construction; these are not expert-ground-truth scores.
